purpose: Record candidate-specific evidence of qualifying data-center exposure that is absent from the three national screening inventories, so contaminated counties cannot enter comparison sets.
qualifying_rule: Exclude a county when a credible source documents a dedicated data-center facility, colocation operation, separately identified institutional data-center building, formal proposal, pre-application, or site-specific developer approach in that county. Ordinary server rooms, accessory IT closets, headquarters without a documented facility, generic policy debate, and facilities merely serving the county from another county do not qualify.
interpretation_note: These findings are conservative contamination exclusions only. They do not add facilities or projects to the active study inventory and do not imply that public or institutional facilities are comparable to hyperscale projects.
